commodity_trap_behavior: Saying 'Hum nayi paint company hain aur paint bechte hain'
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Define Swatch as a 'Factory-Fresh, High-Margin, Zero-Tint Texture System'
field_dialogue_script: [Dealer Name] ji Namaste. Hum paint nahi bechte; hum retail trade counters ke liye ek Zero-Investment High-Margin Texture Coating System supply karte hain jisme bina kisi tinting machine ke aap 40% net cash margin kamate hain.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealer recognizes Swatch as an exclusive business profit system rather than an Asian Paints substitute.
sales_rep_action_rule: Never open a conversation with the word 'paint'. Context sets the value.

commodity_trap_behavior: Comparing directly against Asian Paints, Berger, or local formulators
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Differentiate on business model: Heavy Machine Squeeze vs Zero Machine Direct Profit
field_dialogue_script: Sir Asian Paints ek heavy computerized tinting system hai jisme aapka ₹3.5L capital locked hai aur margin mushkil se 3% milta hai. Swatch ek completely different high-margin direct factory model hai.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealer shifts focus from brand familiarity to return on working capital and cash velocity.
sales_rep_action_rule: Acknowledge the competitor's presence respectfully; never trash them. Contrast the business models.

commodity_trap_behavior: Listing generic features like 'good finish, smooth texture, premium quality'
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Highlight pre-graded natural silica quartz + zero tinting machine dependency
field_dialogue_script: Shahrukh bhai ne Bundi plant me 100% pre-graded washed silica quartz aggregate se pre-mixed formula banaya hai. Counter par koi machine nahi lagani; ready bag kholo aur trowel se seedha apply karo.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealer appreciates zero shop floor clutter
column9: Highlight ready-mixed silica quartz aggregate and show physical 1ft x 1ft cured demo board.

commodity_trap_behavior: Arguing about cost-per-liter or offering random discounts
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Quantify 5X-10X net margin velocity and zero capital lockup
field_dialogue_script: 100 Bori Asian Paints texture bechkar aapko ₹3000 bachta hai. 100 Bori Swatch Rustic bechkar aapko flat ₹40000 se ₹55000 ka direct net cash profit milta hai. Yeh 10x net income multiplier hai.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealer realizes staying with low-margin MNC products exclusively is costing them ₹4.44L annually.
sales_rep_action_rule: Use Keenan & Hormozi arithmetic. Show exact rupee delta per 100 bags.

commodity_trap_behavior: Targeting exclusive luxury paint showrooms locked in MNC exclusivity contracts
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Targeting high-volume hardware & mixed trade retailers with no tinting machine
field_dialogue_script: [Dealer Name] ji aapke counter par daily construction footfall hai lekin aapne tinting machine par ₹3.5L block nahi kiya. Swatch unhi smart counters ke liye design kiya gaya hai jo bina machine ke 40% margin kamaate hain.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealers without expensive tinting machines feel empowered to capture the exterior texture market.
sales_rep_action_rule: Focus on mid-sized hardware and building material trade counters with high footfall.

commodity_trap_behavior: Saying 'Hamara maal Asian Paints se sasta hai'
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Reframe: Asian Paints is for brand display; Swatch is for counter net cash income
field_dialogue_script: [Dealer Name] ji Asian Paints aapke showroom ka brand standard hai use chalne dijiye. Lekin Swatch aapke counter ki asli net income badhane ke liye hai. Wahan 3% margin yahan 40% margin.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealer compartmentalizes products: MNC for brand demand
column8: Never tell the dealer to throw out Asian Paints. Position Swatch as the complementary high-profit engine.

commodity_trap_behavior: Explaining chemical binder solids and polymer chemistry
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Reframe: Swatch is a high-ticket, crack-proof stone elevation texture system
field_dialogue_script: [Dealer Name] ji hum na to normal putty hain na simple paint. Swatch ek Factory-Fresh Exterior Quartz Texture System hai jo deewar ko natural stone look deta hai aur 5 saal tak crack-proof rehta hai with ₹50 token inside.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealer instantly visualizes luxury exterior facades and contractor trowel application pull.
sales_rep_action_rule: Reframe confusing technical questions back to customer aesthetic and painter cash incentive.

commodity_trap_behavior: Lowering dealer price below standard ₹690 rate to match cheap local powder
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Reframe: Price is the entry point to permanent dealer reputation and 40% clean profit
field_dialogue_script: [Dealer Name] ji ₹350 wala local powder 6 mahine me jhad jata hai aur client payment rokta hai. Swatch 100% natural washed silica quartz hai jisme aapka purchase ₹690 aur MRP ₹1150 hai — yani har bag par ₹460 gross margin.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealer understands low price equals high risk of customer complaints
column8: Strictly defend the ₹690 dealer price. Emphasize the ₹460 gross spread against ₹1150 MRP.

commodity_trap_behavior: Arguing that computerized tinting machines are useless
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Reframe tinting machine as an overhead cost center for slow-moving texture bases
field_dialogue_script: Aapki machine interior paint ke hazaaron shades ke liye best hai. Lekin 25kg exterior texture me customer standard natural stone shades chahta hai jisme machine sirf time waste aur canister cleaning badhati hai.
commercial_perception_outcome: Dealer acknowledges that running heavy paste textures through tinting machines causes nozzle blockage and waste.
sales_rep_action_rule: Validate the machine for interior paints; establish Swatch ready-mixed superiority for exterior textures.

commodity_trap_behavior: Sales reps using inconsistent ad-hoc pitches
april_dunford_differentiation_frame: Enforce 10 daily category reframes + 3 comparison breaks + weekly objection audit
field_dialogue_script: Daily Cadence: 10 Positioning pitches -> 5 Category education discussions -> 3 Comparison breaks -> 100% CRM feedback logging.
commercial_perception_outcome: Field sales force speaks with unified
sales_rep_action_rule: authoritative commercial clarity across the entire territory.
column8: Audit reps weekly. Ensure no rep says 'hum paint bechte hain'.
